items.label: 【Waterproof and Durable】
items.value: Our obelisk trellis is made of metal tubes and PE plastic coating, which prevents the tower from rusting, waterproof and able to withstand all kinds of weather conditions, ensuring a long service life.

items.label: 【Adjustable Design】
items.value: Trellis for climbing plants outdoor can be assembled to the right height according to different types of plants and growth cycles, to meet the support needs of plant growth.

items.label: 【Easy Installation】
items.value: Our garden trellis is flush mounted and secured with plastic clips, which ensures the lightweight nature of the trellis. There is no need to use any tools, so you can save time and energy by eliminating tedious installation steps.

items.label: 【Space Saving】
items.value: The garden pot trellis is 65 inches high and features a three-dimensional design that allows plants to grow upwards and take up less space. This way, you can create more green scenery in limited space.

items.label: 【Beautiful and practical】
items.value: Garden trellis is not only practical, but also adds beauty to your garden. It is beautifully designed and can be combined with a variety of flowers and horticultural elements to create a unique and eye-catching garden landscape. Ideal for indoor potted plants, vines, trellises, cucumbers, tomato cage, peas, jasmine and other plants.
